## 1. 执行总纪律

- 本清单只定义后续治理顺序，不代表当前 inspector 已覆盖。
- 后续治理必须从本文件第一条 requirement 开始，逐项执行到最后一条。
- 每项 requirement 的复查动作固定为：读取主干要求 → 对照 inspector 覆盖 → 覆盖不足则补/重写 inspector → inspector 抓出真实违规则修代码。
- 禁止以当前 CI 报错、当前 inspector 报错、当前代码现状作为主线。
- MACHINE 要求必须静态执法；SEMANTIC 要求必须语义质检；HUMAN 要求必须落到 humanApprovalRef / 用户确认门禁。

## L1-02 `capability-group-governance`

- 层级: `L1`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-capability-group-governance.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 能力组与子能力总纲施工图.md`
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye_能力组标准包与执法结构统一施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L1-02-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-CAPABILITY-GROUP-001-V1` — GrassEye uses one fixed ability-group constitution and one execution chain.
- `L1-02-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-CAPABILITY-GROUP-002-V1` — every ability group owns one public contract and one child-boundary catalog.
- `L1-02-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-CAPABILITY-GROUP-003-V1` — Commander, Nerve Bus, and Orchestration each have one fixed authority boundary.
- `L1-02-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-CAPABILITY-GROUP-004-V1` — owner evidence minimum fields are fixed across every governed execution.
- `L1-02-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-CAPABILITY-GROUP-005-V1` — every governed execution must leave evidence, log, and trace.
- `L1-02-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-CAPABILITY-GROUP-006-V1` — ability groups must keep hard boundaries and topology must reflect ownership.
- `L1-02-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-CAPABILITY-GROUP-007-V1` — Capability Catalog is a generated read model, not a new owner.
- `L1-02-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-CAPABILITY-GROUP-008-V1` — AI-generated map authoring must use the governed capability catalog.

## L1-03 `code-purity`

- 层级: `L1`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-code-purity.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 代码纯洁度施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L1-03-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-001-V1` — active source files must stay atomic and must not exceed Code Purity Phase 3.5 file-size limits.
- `L1-03-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-002-V1` — touched oversized files must be split before new logic is added.
- `L1-03-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-003-V1` — functions must stay small, shallow, and single-purpose.
- `L1-03-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-004-V1` — classes and objects must not become god objects.
- `L1-03-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-005-V1` — owner boundaries must be counted at real capability-owner granularity.
- `L1-03-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-006-V1` — imports and exports must not create hidden broad ownership or barrel laundering.
- `L1-03-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-007-V1` — files must have one role and must not mix schema, runtime, validation, execution, persistence, and decision responsibilities.
- `L1-03-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-008-V1` — dead code, fake runtime paths, mocks, placeholders, and temporary bypasses must not survive in active source truth.
- `L1-03-LAW-009` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-009-V1` — refactors must reduce ownership, file size, complexity, and active paths rather than adding compatibility bridges.
- `L1-03-LAW-010` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-010-V1` — disaster files must be identified, blocked, and physically split before meaningful feature debugging continues.
- `L1-03-LAW-011` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-011-V1` — all active code-purity laws must be proven by real enforcement, generated audit artifacts, runner execution, and real-code-inspection.
- `L1-03-LAW-012` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-012-V1` — type-safety and escape hatches must not be used to bypass purity enforcement.
- `L1-03-LAW-013` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-013-V1` — code-purity enforcement must produce inventories, remediation queues, and physical split plans.
- `L1-03-LAW-014` `GRASSEYE-CODE-PURITY-014-V1` — code-purity remediation must use physical deletion and physical splitting, not cosmetic renaming.

## L2-01 `map-plugin-package`

- 层级: `L2`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-map-plugin-package.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Map Prompt Contract Governance 施工图.md`
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 地图插件包治理施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L2-01-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-001-V2` — map packages are declarative route data consumed by Orchestration, not runtime code, child abilities, or new owners.
- `L2-01-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-002-V2` — map packages must pass import, quarantine, validation, human approval, activation, active registry, and re-inspect lifecycle before runtime consumption.
- `L2-01-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-003-V2` — map package schema must contain complete governance metadata and must not depend on runtime truth as package authority.
- `L2-01-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-004-V2` — map packages must never carry executable payloads, runtime code, prompt text, shell scripts, dynamic imports, handlers, or direct ability control.
- `L2-01-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-005-V2` — map packages may reference prompt contracts but must not own prompt content or create prompt double-truth.
- `L2-01-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-006-V2` — AI-generated map packages must be authored against governed catalogs and remain draft/quarantine until all gates and human approval pass.
- `L2-01-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-007-V2` — capability catalog is a generated read model used for authoring and validation; it must not become runtime truth or a second ability registry.
- `L2-01-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-008-V2` — branch condition DSL must be schema-declared, closed, non-executable, and able to reference declared outputSchemaRef fields.
- `L2-01-LAW-009` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-009-V2` — ordinary and developer map surfaces must stay separate, and Commander must not activate or mutate maps without governed validation/approval path.
- `L2-01-LAW-010` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-010-V2` — map activation, validation, approval, prompt binding, and authoring must produce Forensics-compatible proof records.
- `L2-01-LAW-011` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-011-V2` — user-facing map explanation must translate route data into understandable task flow without exposing runtime internals in ordinary mode.
- `L2-01-LAW-012` `GRASSEYE-MAP-PLUGIN-012-V2` — map-plugin-package enforcement must close through owner-local AST/schema/reference inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

## L3-01 `commander-console`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-commander-console-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Commander Console 总司令控制台能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-01-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-COMMANDER-CONSOLE-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Commander Console is the only owner of human command entry and review-disposition entry.
- `L3-01-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-COMMANDER-CONSOLE-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — Commander command envelope must be explicit, map/platform-safe, idempotent, timeout-governed, and semantically validated.
- `L3-01-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-COMMANDER-CONSOLE-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Commander read models are read-only Commander-owned view records sourced from governed read-model ports.
- `L3-01-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-COMMANDER-CONSOLE-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — Commander must not become Orchestration, Nerve Bus, AI, Forensics, browser/action owner, or storage owner.
- `L3-01-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-COMMANDER-CONSOLE-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Commander package must have one canonical root, real child folders, one child registry, one runtime pipeline, and no compat bridge.
- `L3-01-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-COMMANDER-CONSOLE-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Commander runtime result and proof must preserve command/read chain and must never use fake success, null proof, warning-only pass, or throw from public boundary.
- `L3-01-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-COMMANDER-CONSOLE-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — Commander task-template and map-import UX may display governed map lifecycle but must not become map execution, validation, activation, or runtime truth.
- `L3-01-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-COMMANDER-CONSOLE-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — Commander enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, generated artifacts, runner, and real-code-inspection.

## L3-02 `nerve-bus`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-nerve-bus-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Nerve Bus 神经网络传输能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-02-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Nerve Bus is the only owner of governed command/result transport between Commander Console, Orchestration, AI, and Ability Groups.
- `L3-02-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — All Nerve Bus envelopes must preserve complete mission/map/step/capability/prompt chain fields and must fail closed when chain truth is missing.
- `L3-02-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Nerve Bus has exactly six governed logical channels and must not create business-specific or platform-specific transport channels.
- `L3-02-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — Nerve Bus validates, routes, times out, records proof, and returns typed envelopes; it must not make mission, map, AI, action, or storage decisions.
- `L3-02-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Nerve Bus must run a fixed fail-closed transport pipeline.
- `L3-02-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Nerve Bus result semantics must be typed, correlated, payload-ref first, and real-code-inspection-backed.
- `L3-02-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — Nerve Bus transfer proof must preserve full chain, timing, gate decisions, handler decision, payload refs, and correlation refs.
- `L3-02-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — Nerve Bus AI transport must carry Prompt Contract references only and must not carry raw prompt truth.
- `L3-02-LAW-009` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-009-V2` — Nerve Bus children are narrow channel bindings and must use unified runtime.
- `L3-02-LAW-010` `GRASSEYE-NERVE-BUS-CAPABILITY-010-V2` — Nerve Bus enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

## L3-03 `orchestration`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-orchestration-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Orchestration 总指挥能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-03-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-001-V3` — Orchestration is the only owner of mission flow, operational map selection, mission state, step state, branch evaluation, and finalization.
- `L3-03-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-002-V3` — Operational maps are declarative approved packages consumed by Orchestration, not executable code, child abilities, or second runtimes.
- `L3-03-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-003-V3` — Orchestration must freeze map activation snapshot and must not reselect latest map during mission execution.
- `L3-03-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-004-V3` — Orchestration dispatches only through Nerve Bus envelopes and public ability group contracts.
- `L3-03-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-005-V3` — Orchestration step execution must follow the active map and enforce preconditions, PAV after actions, evidence routing, loop guard, and transition closure.
- `L3-03-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-006-V3` — Prompt selection is map-owned and frozen; Orchestration must not build raw prompts or hardcode prompt selection.
- `L3-03-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-007-V3` — Orchestration may request persistence but must not hide finalization, branch, candidate, or delivery-state ownership under Forensics.
- `L3-03-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-008-V3` — Orchestration result and owner evidence must preserve command, map activation, state transition, dispatch envelope, branch, loop, timeout, idempotency, and finalization chain.
- `L3-03-LAW-009` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-009-V3` — Orchestration children are mission lifecycle and transition actions only and must use unified runtime.
- `L3-03-LAW-010` `GRASSEYE-ORCHESTRATION-CAPABILITY-010-V3` — Orchestration enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

## L3-04 `ai`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-ai-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye AI 大脑能力组施工图.md`
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 本地AI分工与提示词施工图.md`
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 本地模型选型施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-04-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-001-V1` — AI is an independent first-class ability group and must remain the only public AI owner.
- `L3-04-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-002-V1` — AI child capabilities represent provider/runtime channels; business task routing is AI-owned and must not replace child ids.
- `L3-04-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-003-V1` — AI may reason and return structured results only; it may not execute actions or side effects.
- `L3-04-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-004-V1` — local-ai-runtime is an internal execution boundary under AI ownership and must not become a second public AI system.
- `L3-04-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-005-V1` — paid and future API AI children are visible but disabled by policy and must fail closed.
- `L3-04-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-005B-V2` — AI outputs must be cleaned before persistence and must not leak AI runtime contracts into Forensics public ownership.
- `L3-04-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-006-V1` — AI keeps a single public contract and does not leak child, adapter, prompt, or legacy internals.
- `L3-04-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-007-V1` — ai-capability inspector is the only enforcement owner for AI topology, runtime pipeline, prompt truth, and anti-escape checks.
- `L3-04-LAW-009` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-008-V1` — AI owns the Prompt Contract Registry; prompt execution must resolve by promptContractId/version/catalog, never by hardcoded prompt text.
- `L3-04-LAW-010` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-009-V1` — Prompt contracts must declare full governed metadata and must be hashable, strict, and audit-proof.
- `L3-04-LAW-011` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-010-V1` — Prompt contracts may guide reasoning only and must not command actions, bypass security, or make final mission decisions.
- `L3-04-LAW-012` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-011-V1` — AI runtime must resolve prompt execution by promptContractId and execute a governed runtime pipeline with typed failures.
- `L3-04-LAW-013` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-012-V1` — AI timeout, cancellation, idempotency, concurrency, and circuit breaker state must be governed and real-code-inspection-backed.
- `L3-04-LAW-014` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-013-V1` — AI result proof must be complete, chain-linked, raw-output-backed, and impossible to fake as success.
- `L3-04-LAW-015` `GRASSEYE-AI-CAPABILITY-014-V1` — AI output boundary must recursively block action authority, browser authority, Forensics authority, and command authority.

## L3-05 `open`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-open-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Open 能力组施工图.md`
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 本地真实Chrome会话与登录态持久化施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-05-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-OPEN-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Open Ability Group is the only owner of governed open behavior.
- `L3-05-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-OPEN-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — Open boundary stays pure and cannot own state, verification, AI, screenshot, visual target, action, Forensics, or mission branching truth.
- `L3-05-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-OPEN-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Open input must carry governed chain fields, target profile context, source proof, timeout, and idempotency.
- `L3-05-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-OPEN-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — Open must run a fixed target/profile/session/navigation/idempotency/timeout/page-state-handoff pipeline.
- `L3-05-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-OPEN-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Open success requires page-state handoff and must not claim page-state readiness or action-result verification.
- `L3-05-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-OPEN-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Open result and owner evidence must preserve real upstream chain, gate decisions, browser attempt refs, timeout/cancellation, idempotency, and page-state handoff.
- `L3-05-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-OPEN-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — child capabilities are narrow target-open bindings and must use unified Open runtime.
- `L3-05-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-OPEN-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — Open enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-page-state-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Page State 页面状态感知能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-06-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-PAGE-STATE-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Page State is the only owner of governed current-page state classification.
- `L3-06-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-PAGE-STATE-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — Page State boundary is pure and may only classify from governed inputs.
- `L3-06-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-PAGE-STATE-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Page State input must carry full chain fields, snapshot proof, observations, evidence refs, policies, and open handoff.
- `L3-06-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-PAGE-STATE-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — Observations and evidence must be source-bound, fresh, and from allowed owners.
- `L3-06-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-PAGE-STATE-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Page State output must be evidence-backed and cannot claim action-result verification truth.
- `L3-06-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-PAGE-STATE-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Page State owner evidence must preserve real chain, gate decisions, source refs, and state fingerprint.
- `L3-06-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-PAGE-STATE-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — child capabilities are narrow state classifiers and must use unified runtime gates.
- `L3-06-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-PAGE-STATE-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — Page State enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

## L3-07 `screenshot`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-screenshot-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Screenshot 能力组施工图.md`
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 多帧视频取证施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-07-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Screenshot Ability Group is the only owner of governed screenshot capture, image artifact truth, coordinate-space truth, and scale mapping.
- `L3-07-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — Screenshot boundary stays pure: capture, lossless optimize, crop/region, AI input preparation, artifact refs, and proof only.
- `L3-07-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Screenshot input must carry full chain fields, source proof, privacy policy, capture policy, idempotency, and timeout.
- `L3-07-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — Screenshot coordinate spaces and scale mapping must be explicit, lossless where claimed, and non-executable until downstream governance.
- `L3-07-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Screenshot runtime must use one fixed gate pipeline and fail closed on privacy, source, session, timeout, artifact, and output-boundary violations.
- `L3-07-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Screenshot result and owner evidence must preserve real chain, artifact refs, hashes, source refs, scale mapping, gate decisions, and parity.
- `L3-07-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — Screenshot child capabilities are narrow capture/transform bindings and must use unified Screenshot runtime.
- `L3-07-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — Screenshot enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.
- `L3-07-LAW-009` `GRASSEYE-SCREENSHOT-CAPABILITY-ARTIFACT-LIFECYCLE-V1` — Screenshot artifacts are transient runtime materials by default and must carry lifecycle manifest, retention, TTL, quota, and non-self-promotion truth.

## L3-08 `visual-target`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-visual-target-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Visual Target 视觉目标定位能力组施工图.md`
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 视觉坐标组合链说明.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-08-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-VISUAL-TARGET-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Visual Target is the only owner of governed visual target result normalization.
- `L3-08-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-VISUAL-TARGET-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — Visual Target boundary stays pure: it validates, normalizes, selects, and builds handoff only.
- `L3-08-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-VISUAL-TARGET-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Visual Target input must carry full chain fields, source proof, candidate proof, policy, and idempotency.
- `L3-08-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-VISUAL-TARGET-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — coordinate-space truth must be explicit; Visual Target output is not executable until Geometry Guard.
- `L3-08-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-VISUAL-TARGET-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Visual Target runtime must use a single gate pipeline and fail closed on ambiguity, stale evidence, source mismatch, and critical data quality.
- `L3-08-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-VISUAL-TARGET-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Visual Target result and owner evidence must preserve real chain, source refs, candidate refs, gate decisions, coordinate transform trace, and Geometry Guard handoff.
- `L3-08-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-VISUAL-TARGET-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — child capabilities are narrow target bindings and must use unified Visual Target runtime.
- `L3-08-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-VISUAL-TARGET-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — Visual Target enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

## L3-09 `geometry-guard`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-geometry-guard-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Geometry Guard 几何安全守卫能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-09-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-GEOMETRY-GUARD-CAPABILITY-001-V3` — Geometry Guard is the only owner of governed executable geometry safety gating.
- `L3-09-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-GEOMETRY-GUARD-CAPABILITY-002-V3` — Geometry Guard public contract must stay clean, native, and independent.
- `L3-09-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-GEOMETRY-GUARD-CAPABILITY-003-V3` — Geometry Guard input must carry full chain fields, source refs, coordinate evidence, idempotency, and policy.
- `L3-09-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-GEOMETRY-GUARD-CAPABILITY-004-V3` — Geometry Guard must validate finite geometry, coordinate space, scale mapping, bounds, click safety, and execution target without silent clamp.
- `L3-09-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-GEOMETRY-GUARD-CAPABILITY-005-V3` — Geometry Guard must use one fixed gate pipeline and must remain side-effect free.
- `L3-09-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-GEOMETRY-GUARD-CAPABILITY-006-V3` — Geometry Guard result and owner evidence must preserve real upstream chain, gate decisions, refs, and normalized geometry.
- `L3-09-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-GEOMETRY-GUARD-CAPABILITY-007-V3` — downstream execution owners must consume only Geometry Guard approved executable geometry and must not redo mapping.
- `L3-09-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-GEOMETRY-GUARD-CAPABILITY-008-V3` — Geometry Guard enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

## L3-10 `mouse-click`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-mouse-click-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Mouse Click 能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-10-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Mouse Click is the only owner of governed primitive click execution.
- `L3-10-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — Mouse Click boundary stays pure and cannot compute coordinates, remap geometry, verify outcomes, or perform foreign owner work.
- `L3-10-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Mouse Click input must carry full chain fields, Geometry Guard allow proof, executable coordinate, safety policy, source refs, idempotency, and timeout policy.
- `L3-10-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — Mouse Click must run one fixed gate pipeline and execute exactly one primitive click only after all gates pass.
- `L3-10-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Mouse Click result must mean primitive click only and must hand off to Post-action Verification.
- `L3-10-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Mouse Click result and owner evidence must preserve real upstream chain, gate decisions, primitive refs, timeout/cancellation, idempotency, and PAV handoff.
- `L3-10-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — Mouse Click children are narrow primitive bindings and must use unified runtime.
- `L3-10-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — Mouse Click enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

### L3-10-LAW-001 `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-CLICK-CAPABILITY-001-V2`

- domain: `mouse-click-capability`

## L3-11 `text-input`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-text-input-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Text Input 输入能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-11-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Text Input is the only owner of governed text/key writing primitives.
- `L3-11-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — Text Input is write-only and must not generate text, locate targets, decide target safety, or verify final page state.
- `L3-11-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Text Input input must carry full mission/map/step/capability chain, approved text proof, verified target proof, focus proof, and Nerve Bus envelope refs.
- `L3-11-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — Text Input executes only through governed execution, clipboard, and clock ports with AbortSignal/timeout and fail-closed semantics.
- `L3-11-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Text Input must treat sensitive text and clipboard content as non-persistent transient material and must record only refs, hashes, redacted previews, and policy decisions.
- `L3-11-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Text Input success is primitive write/key success only and must hand off to Post-action Verification.
- `L3-11-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — Text Input owner evidence must preserve full chain, target proof, focus proof, text proof, clipboard proof, primitive proof, PAV handoff, and redaction decisions.
- `L3-11-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — Text Input children are narrow execution bindings and must use unified runtime.
- `L3-11-LAW-009` `GRASSEYE-TEXT-INPUT-CAPABILITY-009-V2` — Text Input enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol/import-graph inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

## L3-12 `mouse-scroll`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-mouse-scroll-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Mouse Scroll 能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-12-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-SCROLL-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Mouse Scroll is the only owner of governed primitive scroll execution.
- `L3-12-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-SCROLL-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — Mouse Scroll boundary stays pure and cannot compute coordinates, remap geometry, verify outcomes, or perform foreign owner work.
- `L3-12-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-SCROLL-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — Mouse Scroll input must carry full chain fields, Geometry Guard allow proof, explicit direction/magnitude/repeat, safety policy, source refs, idempotency, and timeout policy.
- `L3-12-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-SCROLL-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — Scroll direction, magnitude, delta, and repeat are input/policy only, not child capability or hidden loop.
- `L3-12-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-SCROLL-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — Mouse Scroll must run one fixed gate pipeline and execute primitive scroll only after all gates pass.
- `L3-12-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-MOUSE-SCROLL-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — Mouse Scroll result must mean primitive scroll only and must hand off to Post-action Verification.

## L3-13 `post-action-verification`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-post-action-verification-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Post-action Verification 动作后验证能力组施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-13-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-001-V2` — Post-action Verification is the only owner of governed action-result truth.
- `L3-13-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-002-V2` — PAV boundary stays pure and cannot execute actions, capture evidence, call AI, or persist final evidence.
- `L3-13-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-003-V2` — PAV input must carry action proof, source action refs, expected outcome, before/after evidence, observations, and chain fields.
- `L3-13-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-004-V2` — PAV must verify with bounded observations and evidence; before/after requirements must be enforced by policy.
- `L3-13-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-005-V2` — PAV must return typed verification decision only: verified, failed, or review_required.
- `L3-13-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-006-V2` — PAV owner evidence must preserve the same chain as input and result, without fabricated mission/run truth.
- `L3-13-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-007-V2` — child capabilities must be narrow verification behaviors and must use unified executor/owner evidence path.
- `L3-13-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-008-V2` — PAV enforcement must close through owner-local AST/symbol inspector, runner, and real-code-inspection.

### L3-13-LAW-001 `GRASSEYE-POST-ACTION-VERIFICATION-CAPABILITY-001-V2`

- status: `active`
- tier: `P0`
- domain: `post-action-verification-capability`
- enforcement: `machine-blocking`
- evidence: `law+inspector+real-code-inspection`
- summary: `Post-action Verification is the only owner of governed action-result truth.`

## L3-14 `forensics-persistence`

- 层级: `L3`
- 法案文件: `cursor-rules/modules/module-forensics-persistence-capability.instructions.md`
- lawFileExists: `YES`
- 施工图文件:
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye Forensics Persistence 取证记账能力组施工图_FINAL.md`
  - `法案辅助文件/GrassEye 本地取证存储结构施工图.md`

### Law 清单
- `L3-14-LAW-001` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-001-V2` — Forensics Persistence is the only final evidence-ledger owner and must not be bypassed by local-data, runtime, workbench, Commander, AI, or action abilities.
- `L3-14-LAW-002` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-002-V2` — child abilities must be persistence behaviors and every child must write exactly one governed Forensics record type.
- `L3-14-LAW-003` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-003-V2` — Forensics writes and links records only; it must not reason, verify, decide, act, or reconstruct business truth.
- `L3-14-LAW-004` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-004-V2` — Forensics public contract must be Forensics-native and must not leak legacy business or runtime type sovereignty.
- `L3-14-LAW-005` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-005-V2` — every Forensics record and result must preserve the full execution chain and must be replayable.
- `L3-14-LAW-006` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-006-V2` — storage must be a generic record-store port and old store ownership must stay outside the canonical Forensics root.
- `L3-14-LAW-007` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-007-V2` — Forensics writes must be policy-gated, integrity-gated, idempotent, and append-safe.
- `L3-14-LAW-008` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-008-V2` — Forensics enforcement must be AST/symbol/import-graph based and connected to runner and real-code-inspection.
- `L3-14-LAW-009` `GRASSEYE-FORENSICS-PERSISTENCE-ARTIFACT-PROMOTION-V1` — Forensics is the only owner allowed to promote transient screenshot artifacts into retained evidence or legal hold, and it owns cleanup-ledger truth.
